name: Westfield Fashion Square
description: Westfield Fashion Square is a premier shopping destination in Sherman Oaks, California, featuring a dynamic mix of fashion retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues. This upscale regional mall houses popular brands including Apple, Bloomingdale's, Macy's, Sephora, H&M, and Tesla Motors, offering a comprehensive shopping experience. The center provides modern amenities including free Wi-Fi and electric vehicle charging stations, making it the ultimate destination for food, fashion, and fun in the San Fernando Valley.
summary: Westfield Fashion Square is an upscale regional shopping mall in Sherman Oaks featuring major department stores, popular fashion retailers, diverse dining, and modern amenities including EV charging.
